name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static site content, redirects, security headers, rate limiting, TLS, Fail2ban, firewall, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Sets up Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis persistence, service enablement, authenticated configuration, port 6379, logging, and related configuration integration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with Python virtualenv dependencies, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
